favorites_empty: Mark photos as favorites with the heart and they show up here.
archive_empty: Nothing is archived. What you archive leaves the timeline and is kept here.
archive_hint: Archived photos stay out of the timeline and memories, but remain in your albums and folders.
archive_unarchive_all_confirm: Every archived photo and video will go back to the timeline.
trash_shared_empty: Nothing has been deleted from the shared folders you manage.
trash_restore_all_confirm: Everything in the trash will go back where it was.

match.countPlural=one: {countFormatted} item will be deleted forever, file included. This cannot be undone.
match.countPlural=other: {countFormatted} items will be deleted forever, files included. This cannot be undone.

trash_empty_confirm: Everything in the trash will be deleted forever, files included. This cannot be undone.
trash_shared_hint: Photos deleted from the shared folders you manage. Restoring them puts them back in their folder.
trash_policy_disabled: The trash is turned off on this server: what you delete is deleted permanently.

match.daysPlural=one: Items are deleted permanently {daysFormatted} day after they reach the trash.
match.daysPlural=other: Items are deleted permanently {daysFormatted} days after they reach the trash.

trash_policy_keep_until_emptied: Items stay in the trash until you restore them or empty it.
trash_policy_quota: Above {size}, the oldest items are deleted first.
memories_empty_hint: Photonne prepares them every night from your photos: this day in other years, this month and people through time.
memories_on_this_day_empty: No photos from this day in earlier years.
memories_no_photos: This memory has no photos left.
explore_empty_hint: Scenes, objects and themes show up once the server has analysed your photos; tags, when you add them from the viewer.
explore_tag_note: Also includes photos whose name, folder, description or text contain the word.
explore_text_hint: Find photos by the text in them: signs, receipts, documents or screenshots.
explore_theme_missing: This theme is no longer among your memories.
